posts.title: A human behind the prompt just isn’t the same as an author
posts.description: I said a LinkedIn post sounded like AI had written it. Someone asked why that mattered if I understood it. Well, I can understand three paragraphs about how welcoming a conference is and still have to ask whether there’s a ramp to the stage.

posts.title: Accessibility in healthcare is not just about WCAG conformance
posts.description: A healthcare website can meet WCAG while patients still face barriers to receiving care. Accessibility has to cover the whole service, including the systems, staff and handoffs involved.

posts.title: Disability Simulations, Revisited
posts.description: Disability simulations can reinforce pity, fear, and harmful assumptions about disabled people. Thirteen years after I first wrote about this, the research gives us even more reasons to stop using them.
